values.en: On the closed sets $[0,1/2]\times X$ and $[1/2,1]\times X$, the two formulas are jointly continuous by composition. At the seam they agree: $H(1,x)=f_1(x)=K(0,x)$. The finite closed-cover pasting lemma gives continuity on $I\times X$, with no separation assumption on $X$ or $Y$. At time 0 and 1 the values are $f_0(x)$ and $f_2(x)$.
values.zh-CN: 在闭集 $[0,1/2]\times X$ 与 $[1/2,1]\times X$ 上，两式分别由复合得到联合连续性。接缝处 $H(1,x)=f_1(x)=K(0,x)$，故有限闭覆盖粘合引理给出整个 $I\times X$ 上的连续性，无需对 $X,Y$ 添加分离性假设。时间 0、1 处的值分别为 $f_0(x),f_2(x)$。
